network_policy: Before any navigation: route all page HTTP requests, permitting only this ephemeral 127.0.0.1 static origin with document/stylesheet/script GET; block all other HTTP/API requests. Service workers disabled. All WebSocket routes closed; no separate WebSocket attempt counter. Browser background networking disabled.
pixel_method: For every visible control in each render context, scroll into view and check actual elementFromPoint center hit and horizontal viewport bounds. Focus the intentionally offscreen skip link before measuring it. Direct screenshots reviewed for representative desktop/mobile/forced-color states. This does not inspect every text pixel.
